think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it has any sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch it into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/unlimited). 3) If such sentinel values exist and change semantics beyond the normal ordered scaling, classify as a special knob and record those values. 4) Otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob.
